record.subject: Discrepancy on invoice INV-2026-992
record.body: Hello Support, I noticed my company was charged $450 instead of the agreed $350 monthly rate on invoice INV-2026-992. Please review and clarify.

classification.short_reasoning: Customer notices rate discrepancy on recent invoice INV-2026-992.

verification.short_reasoning: Clear dispute over invoice billing amount.

draft.draft_text:
Hello Sarah,

Thank you for reaching out regarding invoice INV-2026-992. We have received your query concerning the billing discrepancy between the charged amount and your monthly agreement.

Our accounts department has been notified to audit the invoice line items immediately. We will investigate this matter within 1 to 2 business days, and no late fees will accrue during the review.

Warmly,
Billing Support Desk
